entries.name: Medrio RTSM
entries.summary: Medrio RTSM is a configurable clinical trial randomization and trial supply management (IRT/RTSM) application for subject randomization, treatment allocation, stratification, kit assignment, inventory and shipment tracking, automated supply/resupply notifications, expiry tracking and site resupply orders.

leaf_matches.reason: Medrio official RTSM page describes subject randomization, adaptive treatment allocation, stratification, kit assignment, inventory and shipment tracking, automated supply/resupply notifications, expiry management and site resupply orders, including support for single- or double-blind studies.

entries.name: Montrium eTMF Connect
entries.summary: Montrium eTMF Connect is a clinical trial electronic trial master file application with TMF Reference Model structures, document indexing, completeness tracking and inspection readiness.

leaf_matches.reason: Montrium official eTMF page describes TMF Reference Model 3.3.1-aligned structures, study TMF plans/document indexes, placeholders, real-time completeness and missing-document reporting, role-based access, email-to-TMF intake and full audit trails.

entries.name: Montrium Training Management
entries.summary: Montrium Training Management is a training management application for life-science companies whose official page states GxP training management, an automated role/job-title training matrix, retraining when SOPs/policies/work instructions are updated, training-gap reporting, training-completion records, 21 CFR Part 11 eSignatures with Annex 11-compliant digital signatures, audit trails and a Part 11 records center.

leaf_matches.reason: Montrium official training page body contains: 'GxP training management made easy'; an 'Automated training matrix' that distributes activities 'based on role and job title'; 'Automate the distribution of retraining tasks when critical SOPs, policies, and work instructions are updated'; 'Training gaps reporting'; '21 CFR Part 11 eSignatures' with 'Annex 11 compliant digital signatures'; 'Full tracking & audit trails'; 'Real-time progress data' capturing 'training completion information'; and a 'built-in records center to store final records in accordance with 21 CFR Part 11'.

entries.name: MEG Healthcare Quality Management
entries.summary: MEG is a healthcare quality, risk and compliance platform for incident and near-miss reporting, investigations, risk registers, corrective actions, audit/accreditation readiness and policy management.

leaf_matches.reason: MEG official page describes healthcare quality/risk/compliance workflows: incident and near-miss reporting, investigations and root-cause work, risk registers, corrective actions tracked to completion, audit preparation, accreditation readiness and policy management.
